title: The Seventy Elders Receive the Spirit
image_prompt: Courtyard of the Tabernacle: seventy venerable Hebrew elders in white linen robes standing around the sanctuary tent, bathed in a descending supernatural golden celestial light as the Holy Spirit rests upon them, with Moses smiling warmly at their inspired worship.

title: Quails from the Sea
image_prompt: Vast desert plain at sunrise: a strong east wind blowing millions of peaceful brown quails low across the camp perimeter, with Hebrew families gathering baskets of fowl across the sandy dunes under clear morning skies.

title: The Lord Defends Moses the Meek
image_prompt: Tabernacle entrance: the Pillar of Cloud descending to the golden doorframe, Moses standing with gentle humility while Aaron and veiled Miriam bow in deep reverent awe before the radiant divine presence.

title: Moses Prays for Miriam's Healing
image_prompt: Outside the camp perimeter: Moses kneeling in passionate intercessory prayer with hands raised to heaven, pleading for Miriam's complete restoration, while Miriam, draped in a modest full-length travel veil, rests peacefully in a desert tent.

title: Sending the Twelve Spies to Canaan
image_prompt: Rocky desert plateau at Kadesh-barnea: Moses with wooden staff commissioning twelve noble tribal scouts—including Joshua and Caleb in travel tunics—pointing toward the distant green hills of Canaan under bright morning sun.

title: The Cluster of Grapes at Eshcol
image_prompt: Lush sunlit valley of Eshcol: two strong Hebrew scouts carrying a massive, colossal cluster of deep purple ripe grapes suspended from a heavy wooden pole resting across their shoulders, alongside ripe figs and pomegranates in woven baskets.

title: The Report of the Spies
image_prompt: Assembly outside Moses' tent: the twelve scouts displaying the gigantic grape cluster and rich fruit before Moses, Aaron, and the vast congregation, while several scouts speak with fearful gestures of distant fortified stone towers.

title: Joshua and Caleb Urge Faith
image_prompt: Dramatic confrontation in the camp: Caleb and Joshua stepping forward with hands over their hearts, passionately urging the assembly to trust the Lord and possess the fertile land, while the radiant Glory of the Lord appears over the Tabernacle behind them.

title: Moses Pleads for Pardon
image_prompt: Interior sanctuary: Moses prostrate before the golden Ark in deep prayer, appealing to God's eternal mercy, lovingkindness, and longsuffering to forgive the children of Israel, bathed in warm heavenly light.

title: The Forty-Year Wilderness Decree
image_prompt: Sunset over the desert dunes: Moses speaking the solemn divine decree to the assembly, with the towering Pillar of Cloud beginning to lead the vast caravan away from Canaan and back toward the southern wilderness road.

title: The Grain and Drink Offerings of Hope
image_prompt: Sanctuary courtyard: a white-robed Levite priest pouring golden olive oil and clear sweet grape wine from clay flagons beside the bronze altar, symbolizing God's enduring promise of future harvest in the Promised Land.

title: The Ribbons of Blue on the Borders
image_prompt: Dignified Hebrew man and woman in modest, flowing linen garments: close-up detail showing the four corners of their mantles adorned with neat woven fringes and brilliant sky-blue cords, reminding them to remember all the holy commandments.

title: Korah's Challenge at the Sanctuary
image_prompt: Tabernacle entrance: Korah and his company standing defiantly before Moses and Aaron with bronze censers, while humble Moses falls prostrate with his face to the desert sand in prayer to God.

title: The Camp Separates from Korah's Tents
image_prompt: Wide dramatic perspective: the congregation of Israel obediently stepping far back from the isolated tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, as the rocky ground dramatically fractures and separates beneath the rebellious dwellings.

title: Aaron Stands Between the Living and the Dead
image_prompt: High heroic composition: elderly High Priest Aaron in white linen vestments running boldly into the center of the camp carrying a smoking golden censer of sweet incense, standing resolute as an intercessor between the camps to halt the plague.

title: Twelve Rods Laid in the Tabernacle
image_prompt: Most Holy Place at dusk: Moses carefully laying twelve carved wooden tribal walking rods upon the floor before the golden Ark of the Testimony, bathed in the amber glow of the sanctuary oil lamps.

title: Aaron's Rod That Budded
image_prompt: Morning miracle: Moses bringing out the rods before all Israel, holding up Aaron's dry almond rod which has miraculously sprouted lush green leaves, delicate pink-and-white blossoms, and clusters of ripe green almonds.

title: The Covenant of Salt for the Priests
image_prompt: Tabernacle storehouse: Aaron and his sons receiving the tithe offerings of fresh golden olive oil, pure grain, and sweet figs from smiling tribal leaders, celebrated under an eternal covenant of salt.

title: The Tithe of the Tithes
image_prompt: Levite courtyard: white-robed Levites setting apart the finest tenth of all received produce as a special consecrated heave offering to the Lord before the altar.

title: The Red Heifer Without Blemish
image_prompt: Open pastoral meadow outside the camp: a healthy, spotless, unblemished reddish-brown heifer standing quietly beside a priest in linen robes, with red cedarwood and green hyssop branches resting on a clean stone table.

title: The Water of Cleansing and Purification
image_prompt: Ceremonial washing station: a priest using a bundle of green hyssop to sprinkle pure living spring water from a stone basin over travelers, restoring ceremonial cleanliness and purity to the community.

title: Thirst in the Desert of Zin
image_prompt: Parched stony ravine of Kadesh: weary Hebrew families gathered beside empty waterskins, while Moses and Aaron bow their heads before the Tabernacle gate as the divine glory appears.

title: Water Gushes from the Rock at Meribah
image_prompt: Massive granite cliff at Meribah: Moses striking the rock with his staff, a powerful, roaring torrent of crystal-clear fresh water bursting out from the split rock, flowing into wide streams where smiling people and thirsty cattle drink joyfully.

title: The Passing of Aaron on Mount Hor
image_prompt: High summit of Mount Hor at sunset: Moses tenderly removing the holy high priestly breastplate and robe from aged, peaceful Aaron and placing them onto Aaron's faithful son Eleazar, with the purple desert hills stretching out below.

title: The Bronze Serpent on the Pole
image_prompt: Center of the camp: Moses holding high a tall wooden crossbar pole bearing a sculpted bronze serpent, while weary Israelites throughout the camp look up toward the bronze emblem in faith, experiencing miraculous healing and renewed life under golden sunlight.

title: Spring Up, O Well!
image_prompt: Joyful desert gathering at Beer: Hebrew princes and nobles using wooden staves to unearth a stone-lined desert well, singing with joyful smiles as cool sparkling spring water gushes upward into the sand.

title: Marching Past the Amorite Heights
image_prompt: Panoramic view: the peaceful hosts of Israel marching through the fertile plateaus of Gilead and Bashan beneath towering oak trees and sandstone hills, moving safely toward the plains of Moab.

title: Balaam and the Angel in the Vineyard
image_prompt: Narrow dirt path between ancient stone vineyard walls: Balaam's gray donkey stopping short and turning aside into the vines, beholding a radiant, majestic celestial Angel of the Lord standing in the path holding a shimmering sword of divine light.

title: Balaam's Eyes Opened
image_prompt: High-contrast desert road: Balaam falling flat on his face in trembling awe on the rocky road as his spiritual eyes are opened, beholding the luminous Angel of the Lord standing before him under glowing desert clouds.

title: Balaam's First Blessing on Bamoth-baal
image_prompt: High cliff overlooking the valley: Balaam and Moabite King Balak standing beside seven smoking stone altars, Balaam gazing down upon the vast, orderly tents of Israel, proclaiming with arms outstretched that God has blessed this separated people.

title: God is Not a Man That He Should Lie
image_prompt: Peak of Pisgah at golden hour: Balaam speaking solemn divine prophecy to a frustrated King Balak, raising his hand toward heaven to declare that God has blessed Israel, and no curse can undo it.

title: How Goodly Are Thy Tents, O Jacob!
image_prompt: Elevated panoramic masterpiece: Balaam standing on the heights of Peor with wind stirring his prophet's mantle, beholding the sprawling white tents of Israel arranged like green gardens beside rivers and cedar trees beside the waters.

title: The Star Out of Jacob
image_prompt: Nighttime visionary panel: Balaam gazing into the starlit heavens where a magnificent, radiant celestial Star shines with supernatural brilliance above the silhouette of a golden royal sceptre, foretelling the coming King.

title: Phinehas and the Covenant of Peace
image_prompt: Tabernacle court at dusk: young priest Phinehas standing before the altar with hands lifted in passionate, holy intercessory prayer, turning back the plague and receiving God's eternal covenant of peace and everlasting priesthood.
